title: The Hidden Methodological Layer: Uncovering Threats to Validity in LLM-Assisted Empirical Software Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.20033v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in empirical software engineering (ESE) workflows, supporting tasks such as classification, coding, extraction, synthesis, and evaluation. Their probabilistic and opaque behavior, however, introduces methodological concerns that may affect empirical rigor. Aims: This paper investigates threats to validity introduced by LLM-assisted empirical workflows and examines how LLM interactions influence empirical studies. Method: We conducted a secondary analysis of 50 primary studies comprising 69 LLM-assisted research tasks identified through a systematic literature review. We examined the extent to which LLM-related threats were reported, how these threats were characterized, and how they related to established validity dimensions. translated_title: 隐藏的方法论层面：揭示LLM辅助实证软件工程中的效度威胁
translated_abstract: 背景：大语言模型（LLM）日益被嵌入实证软件工程（ESE）工作流中，支持分类、编码、提取、综合和评估等任务。然而，其概率性和不透明的行为引入了可能影响实证研究严谨性的方法论问题。目的：本文研究LLM辅助实证工作流所引入的效度威胁，并考察LLM交互如何影响实证研究。方法：我们对通过系统性文献综述确定的50项原始研究（共包含69个LLM辅助研究任务）进行了二次分析，考察了LLM相关威胁被报告的程度、这些威胁的表征方式，以及它们与既有效度维度之间的关系。结果：LLM相关威胁仍然被严重低估报告。我们识别出反复出现的威胁，包括分类错误、提示词依赖性等问题。
tldr: 该研究通过对50项实证软件工程原始研究的二次分析发现，LLM辅助研究流程引入的效度威胁（如分类错误、提示词依赖性等）在现有文献中被严重低估报告。
